entities.summary: Bobbie Joe Williams Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a guard in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Arkansas Razorbacks and was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the second round of the 2000 NFL draft. Williams also played for the Cincinnati Bengals and Baltimore Ravens.
